name: Mizanur Rahman Hridu
title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
tagline: Architecting clean, scalable solutions with ASP.NET Core, Angular/React & microservices
bio:
Hi, I’m Mizanur Rahman, a Senior Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable backend systems and business-critical software using Microsoft technology stack (C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, Azure) and microservices.  Over the years, I’ve had the opportunity to work with software products and platforms associated with some of the leading companies in Bangladesh, including:
* US-Bangla Airlines — Bangladesh's largest private airline company.
* Banglalink — Bangladesh's 2nd leading telecom operator.
* Bdjobs.com — South asian largest Job Searching platform.
* Foodi — Country’s 2nd largest food delivery system.
In addition, I’ve worked with several top online travel agency platforms, including FirstTrip, TripLover, TakeTrip, TravelChamp, and TakeOff. 
I specialize in backend engineering, third-party API and payment integrations, legacy system modernization, database migration, and performance optimization.

I’m also an AI-assisted developer, using modern AI tools to accelerate development, debugging, research, and problem-solving.
Outside of engineering, I’m a fitness enthusiast. I enjoy continuous learning, mentoring junior engineers, solving challenging technical problems, and documenting my learning and professional journey.
Thank you for taking the time to learn about me.
